entries.source: StA St. Gallen, Zürcher Abt. 6., 1267 IX 20
entries.german:
Abt Berchtold von St. Gallen beurkundet, dass Schenk Rudolf von Tanne ihm die Vogtei über die Stadt Wangen um 200 Mark verpfändet habe.

B. dei gratia abbas totusque conventus monasterii sancti Galli 1 omnibus presentium inspectoribus salutem et noticiam geste rei. Ad tollendam in posterum cuiuslibet contractus calumpniandi materiam utilitas || exegit gesta modernorum scripturarum serie perennari. Noverint ob hoc universi, quod R. pincerna laicus dictus de Tanne 2 ius advocatie seu ipsam advocatiam, que vulgariter dicitur vogteie, oppidi de || Wangen 3 cum pertinentiis suis, quam ipse et sui progenitores a rege C. 4 titulo pignoris possidebant, nobis nomine ecclesie nostre pro ducentis marcis legalis argenti ponderis Constantiensis obligavit ti||tulo prenotato, hiis adiectis conditionibus, quod si idem solutionem dicti pignoris usque ad festum sancti Galli nunc instans et ab inde ad duos annos nobis obtulerit volens liberare dictam advocatiam, sibi restituere non tenebimur, eo quod ipse promisit, infra dictum tempus volens monasterium nostrum b) utilitatem ex hoc consequi qualibet necessitate incumbente ipsum pignus non redimiere, nisi casu contingente tali, quod rex, qui tunc fuerit pro tempore c), ipsum ad hoc faciendum compulerit. Elapso vero tempore d) antedicto, si prefatus R. vel heredes sui oblata solutione ipsam advocatiam redimere voluerint, recepta integraliter pecunia nos seu successores nostri sibi tenebimur restituere libere et absolute possidendam et tenendam, prout prius tenuit et possedit. Et ad hoc faciendum nos astrinximus promittentes una cum venerabili domino A. abbate Augensi 5 in manus reverendi patris domini E. episcopi Constantiensis 6 nos premissa frrmiter observaturos. Quod et nobilis vir V ol. de Guting(en) 7, Egil. de Rosenberg 8, R. de Rorschach 9, R. de Rosenburg 10, Ber. de Kisilegge 11 et R. marscalcus 12 ministeriales ecclesie nostre prestito corporaliter iuramento promovere modis omnibus promiserunt. Renuntiavit etiam idem R. iuri, quod sibi competiit in dicta advocatia, absolvendo ipsos cives de Wang(en) et homines quoslibet ad ipsam advocatiam pertinentes a quolibet genere iuramenti sibi ab ipsis facti, renuntiando nichilominus exceptioni non numerate pecunie, eo quod fatetur presentibus se ipsam recepisse. Nos vero renuntiamus omni iuri et iuris auxilio exceptioni literis impetratis et impetrandis necnon omnibus aliis, per que predictus contractus in alterutrius partis preiudicium posset irritari revocari vel aliquatenus impediri. Et ut premissa robur firmitatis obtineant, presentem cedulam conscribi fecimus et sigillis nostris necnon domini episcopi prenotati et abbatis Augensis communiri. Ego vero R. pincerna fateor premissa, prout premissa sunt, per me facta et nie consentiente sie fore coneepta. In cuius rei evidentiam sigillum meum presentibus apposui et sigillum nobilis viri domini Ber. de Druhburg 13 apponi rogavi. Actum et datum apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini MCCLXVII. XII. kl. octobr. indict. X. pontificatus domini Clementis pape IIII. anno III. Presentibus nobilibus viris Ber. de Druhburg, Ber. de Hohenegge 14, Diethelmo de Toggenburg 15, R. de Tegginhusen 16, item Alberto de Wolkinberg 17, C. de Sulzberg 18, . . marscalco de Wagegge 19, C. de Einwiler 20, H. et Burch. fratribus de Wartinse 21, Wer. Boemo, Hartmanno de Niderndorf 22, Růperto de Tannenvels 23, Cv onone de Veltbach 24, H. de Bilstein 25 et aliis multis.

entries.english: Abbot Berchtold and the whole convent of St. Gall make known that Rudolf, a layman called Schenk von Tanne, pledged to them on behalf of the monastery the right of advocacy over the town of Wangen and its appurtenances for 200 marks of Constance-weight silver. He and his ancestors had held the advocacy from King C. as a pledge. If Rudolf offered repayment by the approaching feast of St. Gall and during the following two years, the monastery was not obliged to return the pledge: Rudolf had promised that, for the monastery’s benefit, it would not be redeemed during that period unless the reigning king compelled redemption. After that period, if Rudolf or his heirs offered full repayment, the monastery or its successors would have to restore the advocacy to them to hold freely as before. The abbot and convent bound themselves to observe these terms before the bishop of Constance, together with the abbot of Augia. The monastery’s ministerials, including Egilolf von Rosenberg and Rudolf von Rosenberg, swore to support the agreement. Rudolf renounced his rights in the advocacy and released the citizens of Wangen and its dependents from oaths made to him; he acknowledged receipt of the money. The parties renounced legal defenses that could invalidate the contract. The charter was sealed by the monastery, bishop, abbot of Augia, Rudolf, and Ber. von Druhburg. Done at St. Gall on 20 September 1267.
